criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Facts, math, code and reasoning are accurate. Any material error caps this at 2.

criteria.name: Instruction following
criteria.description: Does exactly what was asked: format, length, constraints, scope.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.description: Easy to read and well organized. No padding or needless repetition.

criteria.name: Safety and honesty
criteria.description: No harmful advice. Admits uncertainty instead of inventing facts or sources.
